verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe pre-built templates (PyTorch, CUDA implied via GPU images, official Runpod PyTorch template) that eliminate manual environment setup, plus community evidence corroborating ease of using pre-built templates like TheBloke's in a few clicks vs. manual cloud setup. vLLM and ComfyUI aren't explicitly named as templates in the pack, though vLLM serverless workers and public endpoints are documented. Missing for 10: explicit named ComfyUI template evidence and independent hands-on confirmation of the exact template catalog including vLLM/ComfyUI by name.
